_comment: LuV coated conductor line (gtceu:coated_conductor_line, type gtceu:coated_conductor; docs/eras/luv.md, machine 2; package LuV-A3).

server_scripts/grindless/luv/coated_conductor_line.js makes one recipe per entry, id grindless:coated_conductor/<name>; the programmed circuit is the step (1 substrate, 2 tape) and each recipe carries the data key grindless_coated_conductor = <name> (its EMI line).

Substrate: Ni-5at.%W (19 Ni + 1 W), rolled and annealed to a cube texture (RABiTS). Tape: a micron-thick ITBTC film on it, oxygen-annealed, with a silver cap layer: an eighth of a cast single wire's superconductor per tape.
Figures marked tune in luv.md: both EU/t x durations and the tape's ITBTC share.

recipes.name: gd_123_precursor
recipes._why: UIV-A8, line 23: gadolinium oxide and the barium-copper blend fired in oxygen to the Gd-123 phase (GdBa2Cu3O7), the bulk GdBCO's feed.
